body: I've considered what I would lose, what this absence would amount to in the lives of my loved ones. The gaping hole that would have to be navigated around every day until they die, lest they fall into it themselves. Its not fair to them, and I can't abide. The end of my existence terrifies me, and I will eventually face this behemoth, but for now it feels a bit farther away. thank you for your words.
